summary: PWA Install Prompt feature testing completed successfully. All PWA components are properly implemented and accessible.
critical_code_review_comments: PWA manifest.json is valid with all required fields (name, short_name, icons, start_url, display, theme_color, background_color)
Service worker (sw.js) properly implements install, activate, and fetch event handlers with caching strategy
useInstallPrompt hook correctly handles beforeinstallprompt event, iOS detection, and installed state
InstallAppSettings component on Profile page shows correct states for different browser scenarios
InstallBanner component conditionally renders based on installability and iOS detection
iOS install guide modal has clear 3-step instructions with proper icons
Slide-up animation CSS is properly defined in index.css
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA Install Prompt feature is fully implemented. Key components: 1) manifest.json at /public/manifest.json with all PWA fields, 2) Service worker at /public/sw.js with caching logic, 3) useInstallPrompt hook handles browser install events, 4) InstallPrompt.jsx contains InstallButton, InstallBanner, InstallAppSettings, and IOSInstallGuide components, 5) InstallBanner added to Dashboard, 6) InstallAppSettings added to Profile page under Notifications section. Note: beforeinstallprompt event only fires in Chrome/Chromium when PWA criteria are met (HTTPS, valid manifest, registered service worker).

notes: The beforeinstallprompt event is Chrome/Chromium-specific and only fires when PWA criteria are met (HTTPS, valid manifest, registered service worker). In Playwright tests, this event doesn't fire automatically, so we verified component rendering and state handling. The iOS detection correctly identifies iOS Safari users (not iOS Chrome) since only Safari supports Add to Home Screen on iOS.
